groups.heading: Chipotle mayo
ingredients: 1 chipotle pepper plus a little adobo sauce

groups.heading: Method
steps: Brine: dissolve the salt in the water, add the hot sauce and brine the chicken in the fridge for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Flour: mix everything together and dredge the drained chicken and deep-fry at 170 to 175°C until golden and cooked through (75°C at the bone).
Chipotle mayo: blend the mayo, chipotle, adobo and lime and season with salt.
Pickles: bring the vinegar, water, salt and spices to the boil, pour over the cucumbers and dill in a jar and cool.
